description: A commitment to the size and composition of the held-out benchmark split, recorded so the split can be verified when it is eventually opened, without any of its content being available to development code.

availability.statement: Sealed prompt text is unavailable to development code. This repository stores no sealed prompt, no sealed prompt hash, and no path to sealed material. configs/paths.local.json must not name it, no module under src/routegate contains or can infer its location, and the input gates refuse any path whose name suggests held-out material.
enforcement: src/routegate/validation.py rejects paths and configuration values matching generic held-out tokens
the loader refuses any input path that fails that check
a test asserts that the development experiment configuration names no held-out path or filename

release_conditions: the residual-geometry analysis is corrected and frozen
the incremental MoE-feature analysis is complete and frozen
a preregistered protocol for the dynamic-gate evaluation is written, with the joint outcome as the primary endpoint
opening the split is an explicit, logged, one-time action outside the development entry points
